using UnityEngine;

[AddComponentMenu("Gameplay/NoclipController")]
public class NoclipController : MonoBehaviour
{
    public float moveSpeed = 10f;
    public float boostMultiplier = 3f;
    public float mouseSensitivity = 2f;
    public bool lockCursor = true;

    float yaw = 0f;
    float pitch = 0f;

    void Start()
    {
        Vector3 angles = transform.eulerAngles;
        yaw = angles.y;
        pitch = angles.x;
        if (lockCursor) Cursor.lockState = CursorLockMode.Locked;
    }

    void Update()
    {
        // Rotação com mouse
        float mx = Input.GetAxis("Mouse X") * mouseSensitivity;
        float my = -Input.GetAxis("Mouse Y") * mouseSensitivity;
        yaw += mx;
        pitch += my;
        pitch = Mathf.Clamp(pitch, -89f, 89f);
        transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(pitch, yaw, 0f);

        // Movimento local
        Vector3 input = new Vector3(Input.GetAxis("Horizontal"), 0, Input.GetAxis("Vertical"));
        // vertical (subir/descer)
        if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.E)) input.y += 1f;
        if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Q)) input.y -= 1f;

        float speed = moveSpeed;
        if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.LeftShift) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.RightShift)) speed *= boostMultiplier;

        Vector3 movement = transform.TransformDirection(input) * speed * Time.deltaTime;
        transform.position += movement;
    }
}extends Spatial

export var speed := 10.0
export var boost := 3.0
export var sensitivity := 0.3

var yaw := 0.0
var pitch := 0.0

func _ready():
    Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED)

func _unhandled_input(event):
    if event is InputEventMouseMotion:
        yaw -= event.relative.x * sensitivity * 0.01
        pitch -= event.relative.y * sensitivity * 0.01
        pitch = clamp(pitch, -1.5, 1.5)
        rotation = Vector3(pitch, yaw, 0)

func _process(delta):
    var dir = Vector3.ZERO
    if Input.is_action_pressed("ui_up"): dir -= transform.basis.z
    if Input.is_action_pressed("ui_down"): dir += transform.basis.z
    if Input.is_action_pressed("ui_left"): dir -= transform.basis.x
    if Input.is_action_pressed("ui_right"): dir += transform.basis.x
    if Input.is_action_pressed("move_up"): dir += transform.basis.y
    if Input.is_action_pressed("move_down"): dir -= transform.basis.y

    var s = speed
    if Input.is_action_pressed("ui_shift"): s *= boost
    if dir != Vector3.ZERO:
        translation += dir.normalized() * s * deltaimport pygame, sys
pygame.init()
w,h = 800,600
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((w,h))
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

x,y = w//2, h//2
speed = 300

while True:
    dt = clock.tick(60)/1000.0
    for e in pygame.event.get():
        if e.type == pygame.QUIT:
            pygame.quit(); sys.exit()

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    dx = (keys[pygame.K_d] - keys[pygame.K_a]) * speed * dt
    dy = (keys[pygame.K_s] - keys[pygame.K_w]) * speed * dt
    if keys[pygame.K_LSHIFT]: dx *= 2; dy *= 2

    x += dx
    y += dy

    screen.fill((30,30,30))
    # desenha "paredes" só como referência — não há colisão
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (200,50,50), (100,100,600,50))
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (200,50,50), (100,450,600,50))

    pygame.draw.circle(screen, (50,200,50), (int(x),int(y)), 10)
    pygame.display.flip()-- Server: Admin validation + RemoteEvent handler
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Crie um RemoteEvent em ReplicatedStorage chamado "AdminAction"
local adminEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AdminAction")
if not adminEvent then
    adminEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    adminEvent.Name = "AdminAction"
    adminEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

-- Lista de admins (coloque aqui os UserIds dos seus administradores)
local ADMINS = {
    [12345678] = true, -- substitua por IDs reais
    [87654321] = true,
}

local function isAdmin(player)
    if not player then return false end
    return ADMINS[player.UserId] == true
end

-- Ações permitidas pelo admin (servidor valida)
adminEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, params)
    if not isAdmin(player) then
        warn(player.Name .. " tentou executar ação admin sem permissão: " .. tostring(action))
        return
    end

    if action == "RequestAdmin" then
        -- confirma que esse jogador é admin (retorno via RemoteEvent se quiser)
        adminEvent:FireClient(player, "AdminGranted", {})
    elseif action == "RespawnPlayer" then
        local target = params and params.targetPlayer
        if typeof(target) == "Instance" and target:IsA("Player") and target.Character then
            -- Respawn para testes (não é um ataque)
            target:LoadCharacter()
        end
    elseif action == "TeleportTo" then
        local target = params and params.targetPlayer
        local pos = params and params.position
        if typeof(target) == "Instance" and target:IsA("Player") and target.Character and typeof(pos) == "Vector3" then
            local hrp = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) end
        end
    else
        warn("Ação admin desconhecida: " .. tostring(action))
    end
end)-- Local: Fly + Noclip para admins (ativa somente após confirmação do servidor)
